tasks.title: Extract person info
tasks.prompt:
From the passage below, extract the person's name, age, and city. Return a JSON object with fields "name" (string), "age" (integer), and "city" (string).

Passage:
"Alice Smith is 30 years old and lives in New York."

Return only the JSON object.

tasks.title: Extract book details
tasks.prompt:
From the passage below, extract the book title, author, and year published. Return a JSON object with fields "title" (string), "author" (string), "year" (integer).

Passage:
"The novel "1984" was written by George Orwell and published in 1949."

Return only the JSON object.

tasks.title: Extract product info with price
tasks.prompt:
From the passage below, extract the product name, price (in USD), and availability. Return a JSON object with fields "name" (string), "price" (number), "available" (boolean).

Passage:
"The Widget Pro costs $19.99 and is currently in stock."

Return only the JSON object.

tasks.title: Extract meeting details
tasks.prompt:
From the passage below, extract the meeting date, start time, and end time. Return a JSON object with fields "date" (string in YYYY-MM-DD), "start" (string in HH:MM), "end" (string in HH:MM).

Passage:
"The team meeting is scheduled for 2026-04-15 from 09:30 to 11:00."

Return only the JSON object.

tasks.title: Extract multiple persons
tasks.prompt:
From the passage below, extract all persons mentioned and their roles. Return a JSON object with a field "persons" that is a list of objects, each with "name" (string) and "role" (string).

Passage:
"Dr. Alice Chen (cardiologist) and Engineer Bob Lewis (software) attended the conference."

Return only the JSON object.

tasks.title: Extract order with items and total
tasks.prompt:
From the passage below, extract the customer name, order date, list of items, and total amount. Return a JSON object with fields "customer" (string), "date" (string YYYY-MM-DD), "items" (list of strings), "total" (number).

Passage:
"Customer John Doe placed an order on 2026-05-01 for items: apple, banana, orange. The total was $12.50."

Return only the JSON object.
